ms.promise: A Diagram and explainer video will be provided that will show the user journey through Cardano Mainstreet Suite. This Diagram deliverable includes end user experience, as well as the technical requirements for the end user, and for the architecture to deliver the experience to the user. The explainer video will highlight the results of our user research and our end user surveys.
ms.criteria: Our User journey diagram will show the user onboarding experience for merchants and customers. The diagram will lay out expected technical requirements for both the end user and the systems/servers.The explainer video will include highlights from our research and our end user surveys.
ms.report:
We completed Milestone 1 - The User Journey Walkthrough. We released a survey, evaluated the data from the survey, and created a video to share the results so far, as well as the methods we used to create the user survey. In the video we discuss the basic design principles that our users will experience as they are onboarded to the application. We also list the basic user technology requirements. The project is on track for completion. 

https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1ogaCWqnA-n8zWndn2bEP6o6FH47HgvPv71BBO1vbQQs/edit?usp=sharing Is the Slides of our User Survey Data and Walkthrough 

Here is our YouTube Video presentation: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WzfTjRaCyew

ms.report: We have completed the coding for the front end (android/apple mobile development) up to the point of integration with our payment rail provider. The demonstrator video here shows a native view of our mobile interface, and walks through a full end to end transaction between a brand new merchant and an established end user. The video points out the moments where we will need to interact with the payment rail provider via an API we are developing. We also discuss some of the behind the scenes tasks that have begun for full legal compliance. Please see the video here: https://youtu.be/EsBg3Rs5Kyw

ms.promise:
After completion of a thorough testing and integration round, we will submit a demonstrator/pilot version of our software, with the the ability to sample the onboarding and the creation of a product. The software will be able to show a test transaction on the Fireblocks system and the Cardano Preview testnet.

Our product Demonstrator pilot software will be functional on the third party testnet, and ready to be used for exposure and fund raising. We will have created a system that allows a small business to set acceptable tokens/currencies to receive for their goods. 

We will have created an on ramp for consumers to easily identify, load a wallet, and shop in the marketplace. 

Our system will allow the merchant and customer to track the exchange of goods and services with one another.
ms.criteria: Video preview of product Proof of Concept operational in third party testnet environment
ms.report:

ms.promise:
The application is now at an MVP for fundraising. The following features are operational in an APK file that can be loaded to a phone and be demonstrated with minimal guidance.
・Allow merchants to list physical or virtual products for sale. 
・Provide a seamless onramp for new customers to fund wallets. 
・Facilitate the completion of sales 
・Allow all users to withdraw proceeds to the appropriate account or wallet
・Manage and track the results of sales for the merchant and customer
ms.criteria:
・Put my name in the product, quit and startup again. The product remains in the system.
・Wallet will be provisioned via Fireblocks backend when test information is added.
・Demonstrate this with 1 all new product listing, and new wallet making the purchase/sale
・User provides a testnet wallet and proceeds are sent to that wallet from the Fireblocks system.
・Report generated in new wallet of merchant and customer which shows completed transaction.
